propositions: Add optional enforce_plan_material_pins configuration to VerifyConfig with key-local fail-open rollout behavior that catches ConfigError and returns false with structured warning.
Derive DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract with pin_status aggregated by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current), enforced flag, and per-target TargetPinDetail list.
When enforcement is enabled, pin drift, malformed pins, or deleted pinned targets invalidate plan-review attestations; when disabled, report same observations as advisory while keeping valid true.

Re-sign recovery validates review-time sidecar related_material pins through derive_plan_material_pin_health without calling compute_validity, refusing re-sign only when enforcement detects drift or malformed records.

Drift refresh delegates signature, kind, reopen, registry, own-material, and pin validity checks to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) with full ticket_state, retaining only code-drift qualification inline.

Full LLM review threads pre-LLM review_snapshot.related_material through sidecar.emit() and build_payload() as optional reviewed_related_material field while preserving plan_review_result_v2 schema identifier.
